CustomField.description: Date of the most recent PAID payment on this gift. Native roll-up (MAX of Payment Date where Paid = true) rather than a flow-stamped field: Payment is a master-detail child, so this stays real-time and delete-safe with no DML. Used by the installment notification emails, which cannot merge Payment fields directly because the Payment object has activities disabled and so cannot be an email template's whatId. JSI-125 / Jason Ott.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date of the most recent paid payment on this gift.
CustomField.label: Last Payment Date
